summary: Compared with dmrconfig dfu-libusb.c and QDMR tyt_interface.cc/dfu_libusb.cc (commit fb9c96af): both abort download/upload-idle back to dfuIDLE, re-enter 91 01 before erasing, use unlimited control timeouts, and QDMR ignores every error from erase_block. Image after the failed write equals the earlier read except the edited byte at 0x2d004, so no erase happened.
